gaps: The settled combined-review decision is not applied and the protected execution contracts still assign it elsewhere.
The phrase review stays with the active orchestrator direct permits inline self-certification.
The amendment has no identifiable new delivery owner because its only decomposition row is already shipped.
Historical instruction-level motivation is presented as current behavior and the text claims four boundaries while listing three.
The locked canon surface omits all non-workflow .github paths and WORKFLOW.md required by Decision 0037.
Orchestration surfaces stay writable exactly as today is unstable and conflicts with the shared path classifier and protected-record ownership.
Client inheritance is ambiguous because vendored client machinery follows a different replacement boundary and no delivery proof is required.
The degraded-window criterion incorrectly allows the same edit without the five-file, classifiable-write, and repository-kind-marker limits.
The outage exception is Claude-companion-specific and makes native repair depend on Claude.
Admitted delegated worker has no acceptance coverage for task, stage, process, worktree, scope, stale, or revoked state.
The exploration lane is time-relative and does not distinguish Claude rescue, native in-session read-only work, and unshipped native helper commands.
resolutions: The revision now states that the dual-coordinator capability and its approved task contract own combined-review packaging, while FORGE-COORD-1/NATIVE-FOREGROUND-ACTIVATE owns the current adapter wording and native admission. The separately amended story/decomposition/task artifacts apply the user-set D-0032 ownership before implementation; this spec does not duplicate that protocol.
The boundary now says the active orchestrator directly launches one independent Codex autoreview operation and never performs the assessment inline or self-certifies.
The decomposition distinguishes the shipped FORGE-ROLE-1 origin from the current FORGE-COORD-1/NATIVE-FOREGROUND-ACTIVATE amendment and names its bounded responsibilities.
The Why section marks instruction-only behavior as historical, states that the hook now enforces the boundary, and correctly identifies three original boundaries.
The locked set now names all .github paths, constitution, factory machinery, AGENTS.md, WORKFLOW.md, and vendored adapters consistently with Decision 0037.

The revision delegates orchestration exemptions to the shared repository path classifier, lists its current prefixes/files, and says protected .factory state changes only through recorders and owning commands.
The client criterion now distinguishes client-owned locked product/canon from replaceable vendored machinery and requires init/adopt/upgrade proof that both adapters retain enforcement.
The degraded criterion now requires an exact classifiable in-scope write within five distinct files and rejects a sixth, opaque/globbed write, or repository-kind-marker change.

The outage valve now applies to the configured delegated-writer path after ordinary repair, and explicitly says native repair does not require Claude or codex-plugin-cc; docs/degraded-mode.md is aligned in the same canon change.
The acceptance criteria now require matching live worker process, task, stage, kind, worktree, and scope and reject unregistered, stale, revoked, wrong-task, wrong-worktree, and out-of-scope writers.

The revision pins Claude read-only discovery to /codex:rescue, permits native read-only exploration in the current coordinator session, and requires unshipped native explore/background commands to refuse before dispatch until their lifecycle owner lands.
